name: Alexis M.
text: Reached out for a shower enclosure estimate and Frank responded the same day. He walked me through hardware options, explained the warranty coverage, and made sure everything stayed within budget. Really appreciated how knowledgeable and clear they were from the very first call.

name: Jesus R.
text: Frank came out to measure for glass partitions in our office and recommended 1/2-inch glass for the space. The crew completed the installation cleanly and professionally. Solid commercial work — would use them again without hesitation.

name: Jaquelyn S.
text: We went with a frameless shower enclosure using starphire glass and brass hardware — the combination is stunning. Installation was perfect and the bathroom feels so much brighter now. Couldn't be happier with how it turned out.

name: Salinas R.
text: I wasn't sure about going frameless at first but Frank and Bryant took the time to walk me through the design options and explain what would work best. The result is exactly what I hoped for — solid, quality work from a team that clearly knows their craft.

name: Erendira N.
text: The shower glass completely transformed the space — it feels like a different bathroom. Competitive pricing, strong product knowledge, and Eddie kept me updated throughout the whole process. Clear communication from start to finish.

name: Kevin F.
text: From the first call to the final installation, everything was perfect. Bryant and Franklin helped turn our shower glass vision into exactly what we wanted. Professional, skilled, and a real pleasure to work with.

name: Maryuri T.
text: Had some boutique mirrors done and the quality is great. Bryant was knowledgeable and professional throughout — offered honest advice and special pricing. Happy with how everything came out and would use them again.

name: Jesus S.
text: Got a neo-angle shower installed with beautiful brass hardware — fits perfectly in the smaller bathroom and looks incredible. The quality is outstanding and the whole team was professional from start to finish. Very happy with the result.

name: Elise Z.
text: The job was done well and professionally from start to finish. Our tenants were very happy with the completed work, which says everything. Would definitely recommend American Glass Experts for any glass installation.

name: Joshua B.
text: Bryant and Franklin did an amazing job on our shower glass. Installation was done within five days and the overall price was great. The whole process was smooth from measuring to finishing touches — couldn't be happier.

name: Jose V.
text: Bryant was no pressure, informative, knowledgeable and patient. On install day, all the guys were friendly, professional, hard working and clean. The windows and slider are amazing — easy to open, self locking, and beautiful. The noise reduction is remarkable. I added one additional window on install day and they made a point to install it that day. They deserve more than 5 stars.

name: Kelvin T.
text: Frank and his team came out to measure both bathrooms for frameless glass doors and panels. Everything turned out beautifully and pricing was great compared to other quotes. The process was quick and smooth and the team was professional throughout. Would definitely use them again.

name: Luis D.
text: Got a mirror installed in the master bathroom and it turned out really nice. They offered 1/4-inch mirror and the quality is solid. Fits perfectly on the wall. Clean work, straightforward process.

name: Mercy R.
text: Needed a broken window replaced and American Glass Experts exceeded all expectations. Exceptional attention to detail — installed seamlessly and fast. The team made sure everything was clean and tidy after the job. Would definitely hire them again.

name: Dylan N.
text: American Glass Experts is one of the best in the game. Bryant and Frank are true professionals — they go above and beyond to make sure you're satisfied. Highly recommend them for any glass need, big or small.

name: Lisandro O.
text: Responded quickly, arrived within days to measure, and finished ahead of schedule. The insulated tempered glass panel was installed with real precision and the moulding was reattached so cleanly that no repainting was needed. Thorough cleanup after — couldn't tell anyone had been there.

name: Jennifer S.
text: A friendly neighbor recommended them after seeing her beautiful bathroom. Was skeptical at first but completely sold once I saw the work. They provided a high-quality, elegant shower door — the installation required real skill which the gentlemen delivered. The time and patience they took to make sure I loved the result was the perfect level of service.
